q1.sampleAnswer: My name is Wang Fang. I’m twelve years old. I live in Chengdu, in China. I like to buy books or nice pens for my friends, because they are useful. I usually receive presents on my birthday and at Spring Festival. Last year my parents gave me a new bike for my birthday. I really liked it because I can ride it to school, and it’s a beautiful blue colour. I usually watch films at home with my family, but sometimes we go to the cinema. I spend my free time with my best friend. We play badminton in the park.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法与词汇：简单语法结构的掌握，日常话题词汇的运用
互动交流：回答切题，内容充分，能延展回答
整体表现：能用简单的语言完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答能直接回答每个问题，并多说一两句理由或细节（例如喜欢给朋友买什么礼物、收到过哪件最喜欢的礼物以及为什么喜欢），用简单而正确的句子连贯表达。

q2.sampleAnswer: I like science because doing experiments is exciting. I don’t like history very much, because there are too many dates to remember. I think maths is important, because we use it every day, for example when we go shopping. Geography is useful because we learn about different countries. History is interesting sometimes, when the teacher tells us stories about old castles. Science is fun, because we can do experiments in the lab. Art isn’t easy for me, because I can’t draw very well. I like science best. I like learning with a teacher, because the teacher can help me when I don’t understand something. I prefer reading homework, because I love reading stories and it’s more relaxing than writing.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答会对图片中的每门学科表明喜欢与否并给出理由，能回答考官的追问（如数学是否重要、美术是否容易等），说出最喜欢哪一门，并用 because 等连接词展开。
